prompt:
Create one photoreal horror-game concept image, landscape 16:9. Reference 1 (07) is the authoritative court-level camera and stepped amphitheatre geometry: preserve this composition and bowl exactly, remove doll. Reference 2 (08) clarifies the broad horizontal terrace setbacks. Reference 3 (12) is ONLY the deep-red finale lighting reference, NOT its vertical gallery geometry.
Standing in the central court looking up a huge STEPPED bowl of soft-play terraces. Six concentric rings, 2 storeys at the court, then 4,6,8,10,12 against the far concrete wall. Each successive ring set back 11 metres, broad terraces like stadium steps, clearly receding UP AND AWAY. No vertical wall of galleries. Round hall 155m across, steel truss ceiling 42m up. Padded coloured posts, black knotted safety nets, worn vinyl decks, crawl tubes and bubble windows fill the rings. Blue-green checker foam court, yellow ring, short red padded post foreground on yellow ring. NO figure.
Everything illuminated DEEP RED: red fluorescent strips, red haze, deep red shadows, like reference 3. On HIGHEST terrace at FAR WALL, small and distant, one GREEN lamp is clearly the brightest thing in the image above the round OPEN mouth of a gigantic solid-red enclosed tube slide. The slide connects continuously from this top mouth into THREE visibly distinct corkscrew turns descending outside the top ring, then a straight tube segment penetrates the concrete hall wall. Keep slide distant at the outermost ring, not sprawling across the court. Show all three coils and wall penetration clearly. One straight foam stair aisle climbs all the terraces from court toward green light, faintly picked out green by spill from the single lamp. Lamp must stay small distant but brightest; no other green lamps.
Wide lens, abandoned dusty realistic materials, ominous atmosphere. Preserve reference 1 camera, architectural bowl and foreground composition. No humans, no doll, no text, no signage, no HUD, no watermark, no striped slides.
weakness: Bowl still too vertical; extra green lamp; main lamp not brightest; three slide turns and wall-exit continuity unclear.
